hero.title: Gather Feedback Like a Pro
hero.subtitle: An open-source, fast, and simple feedback management system. Built for makers to listen to their users.

items.title: Open Source
items.description: Fully open source and free to use. Host it yourself and maintain full control.

items.title: Fast & Lightweight
items.description: Built on the edge with Next.js and Cloudflare Workers. Lightning fast performance.

items.title: Global Ready
items.description: Built-in i18n support for multiple languages out of the box.

items.title: Deep AI Integration
items.description: Built-in LLM-powered automatic translation (live), with planned AI classification and sentiment analysis. Leverage free tiers for better efficiency and lower costs.

items.question: Is it completely free?
items.answer: Yes, it is fully open-source. You can deploy it to Cloudflare's free tier.

items.question: How do I deploy it?
items.answer: Simply click the 'Deploy to Cloudflare' button or follow the instructions in our GitHub repository.

items.quote: This is exactly what I needed to collect feedback for my side project. Super easy to set up!
items.author: Open Source Maker
